Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 31

“And I see adverse omens, Keshava. I foresee no good in killing my own people in battle.”

Arjuna reaches for omens, the standard way of reading a battlefield, and finds them all against him. But notice the second line — he has already begun arguing from conscience rather than signs.
